name: Mobile EEG split-belt walking study
readme:
[![DOI](https://img.shields.io/badge/DOI-10.82901%2Fnemar.on004475-blue)](https://doi.org/10.82901/nemar.on004475)
This mobile brain body imaging (MoBI) experiment investigates brain activity correlated to gait adaptation during split-belt treadmill walking. 30 participants completed an abrupt and gradual split-belt walking paradigm (2:1 belt speed ratio).
acknowledgements: Noelle A. Jacobsen and Daniel P. Ferris (2023). Mobile EEG split-belt walking study. OpenNeuro. [Dataset] doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds004475.v1.0.0
